name: B10-0089/2025 (S&D) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Boualem Sansal, a French-Algerian writer held in Algeria since November 2024. He faces charges that could mean life in prison. The Parliament asks Algeria to drop the charges and free everyone jailed for speaking out or protesting peacefully. It also urges the European Union to raise these cases publicly with Algeria and to give more support to journalists and human rights defenders. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks Algeria to release Sansal and other detainees and drop charges.
- **Who it affects:** Boualem Sansal, jailed journalists and activists in Algeria, and Algeria's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Algerian authorities, the European Commission and member states.
